items.title: File Widerspruch against GdB determination
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb eines Monats Widerspruch erheben, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift beim Versorgungsamt Beispielfeld, Am Versorgungsamt 1, 49074 Musterosna.
items.computation: The notice is dated 27.05.2026 (Wednesday); assuming it was handed to the post (Aufgabe zur Post) on that same day, the letter's own rule applies: it 'gilt am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post als bekannt gegeben' -> 27.05.2026 + 4 days = 31.05.2026 (a Sunday). This fictional notice date is not itself a procedural deadline, so case law does not shift it to the next business day for falling on a Sunday. The one-month Widerspruchsfrist begins the day after Bekanntgabe (§187 Abs. 1 BGB analog, per § 26 Abs. 1 SGB X) and, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, ends on the day of the following month that bears the same date number as the day of the triggering event (31). June has only 30 days, so under § 188 Abs. 3 BGB the period ends on the last day of June: 30.06.2026 (Tuesday). This day is a normal working day in NRW (Fronleichnam 2026 falls on 04.06.2026, not on 30.06.2026), so § 193 BGB causes no further shift.

warnings: The exact date the Bescheid was actually handed to the post (Aufgabe zur Post) is not stated in the letter; the computation assumes it matches the printed document date (27.05.2026), which affects the computed Widerspruch deadline.

Note for the reader: by today's date (2026-10-01) this one-month Widerspruchsfrist (computed as 30.06.2026) has already expired; if a Widerspruch is still needed, check with the Versorgungsamt about possible reinstatement (Wiedereinsetzung in den vorigen Stand) or whether the notice was actually received on a different date.
